pros: business-level + lat/lng + 업종 대/중/소 + stable ID

reason: license: 이용허락범위 제한 없음 → 상업 이용·가공·통계 공표 가능(출처표시)
business-level coverage + lat/lng → 1km straight-line census 가능
ingest cost: sido CSV stream filter로 잠실엘스 PoC 가능(전체 적재 불필요)

architectureProposalOnly.requestPath: read-only derived snapshot (no full scan / no write on request)
architectureProposalOnly.updateCadence: quarterly align with SEMAS file release

fullSeoulRoughEstimate.storageScale: Seoul CSV ~288MB uncompressed; nationwide zip ~337MB compressed / ~1.5GB uncompressed across sido files
fullSeoulRoughEstimate.futureIngestionWorkload: download zip → extract target sido → upsert by 상가업소번호 → precompute complex 1km aggregates
fullSeoulRoughEstimate.mainBottleneck: bulk file size + quarterly full refresh; request-time aggregation must be avoided

decision.nextActionReason: 1순위 source와 잠실엘스 1km census가 PASS이므로, 다음으로 offline ingest + derived commerce snapshot pilot를 최소 구조로 진행. size label은 다단지 분포(A) 이후.
